Default angle style wraps URLs containing spaces in angle brackets

```python title="Python"
from html_to_markdown import convert, ConversionOptions, UrlEscapeStyle

def main() -> None:
    html = '<a href="/file (1).pdf">file</a>'
    options = ConversionOptions(url_escape_style=UrlEscapeStyle("Angle"))
    result = convert(html, options)
    print(result.content)

main()
```
